## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** Both extended policies (baseline, all five factors' full ladders each, assembly, overwrites, tool contract, prerequisite), their base policies and the rest of the charter correspond losslessly; the retired surface is complete; nothing is unsourced.

Policy-side note (not a KB verdict): the same overwrite that supplies this task's offer-price rule retires "when the two notices differ, the final_options_notice governs" for the whole base policy while `bizgas_ext_renewal_loyalty_credit` restates it for pre-expiry acceptances (see policy_kb/0.md); the KB mirrors this faithfully.
